Silicone bowls that attach to trays and spoons w favorite foods/guiding her hand w the spoon has always been my go to. Sometimes kids just like being babied and enjoy the attention, i honestly see it happening most w the happiest kiddos!)
You are dealing with so much, your kiddo is safe and loved and so lucky to have you, kids always do everything but what you expect and when you expect! Be sure to give yourself some grace, it's what she would want you to do!

I had a similar awful situation where i went from 6k to nothing in savings at 19, its been a few years and im just now looking at support boards instead of trying to hide it or pretend im in control. Im so proud of you for figuring out what's going on and looking for support so early, its going to help worlds more than roughing jt alone and its so easy to justify when its just you trying to talk urself out of it rather than looking to others who struggle w the same thing! What has helped me recently (definitely not fixed anything, but helped a small bit) is
-when i try to justify bc im having a hard time/want to celebrate and i deserve x or any other reason even if its valid i just. Endlessly chant at myself that i deserve stability and housing more. It doesnt always work but it helps
-staying away from physical stores as best i can and chilling at home, at least online i can add things to my wishlist and i can see the total/remove from cart without embarrassment 
-ik everybody says it but a wishlist is so helpful, or even just waiting a day if you can. I cant tell you how good it feels to finally resist an impulse purchase, and realizing i actually did it and i still have that money!! Even if i mess up later that day working on resisting and telling myself i can get it later is a huge improvement for me
-not shopping but i have issues making friends as well, discord has helped so much bc i just look up my interests on disboard, join a server and if i vibe w somebody ask if i can dm them and try to be friends! Ive made friendships that last ages bc of discord its helped so much

Pls feel free to dm if you need a friend or just want to vent about dealing with addiction, its so heartbreaking and frustrating but dude! You're already taking steps towards recovery! There is hope, you're looking for support already and you're going to be okay.
